`tdx_quote` and `tdx_quote_collateral.json` are the upstream signed test fixtures from https://github.com/Phala-Network/dcap-qvl/tree/master/sample, retrieved 2026-10-07. Upstream Apache-2.0 license applies. Their signed collateral expires in July 2025; tests verify them at Unix 1751000000 and explicitly reject them at the current time. They are never used to issue app receipts or simulate hardware verification. Separate synthetic report mutations exercise application policy after cryptographic verification tests.
